description: This PHP class 'zipFolder' provides functionality to create ZIP archives from a directory structure, including handling nested directories and ignoring specified files.

classes.name: zipFolder
classes.description: A class to compress a directory and its contents into a ZIP archive, with support for nested directories and ignored files.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the object by opening/creating the ZIP file, setting up the root directory, and adding the specified folder contents into the ZIP archive.

methods.name: zip
methods.description: Recursively adds directories and files from the specified folder into the ZIP archive, respecting the ignored files list.
